title: What the class took from the book
header_line: My analysis of one book on negotiation. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: What is the one thing you will take from this book?
A student said that the biggest thing he learned is approaching every conversation more mindfully, listening more and understanding the impact of what you say.
Another said that you can take actions to uncover black swans yourself.
I said that the single thing is awareness: looking for them everywhere.
I said that everyone's interpretation of the book is different, and that one of the big things I learned is that I need to be more disciplined myself.

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write your one takeaway from the book.
Write the first thing you will do on Monday.
Write who you will practise it with.
Write what you need to be more disciplined about.
Write the date you will review.
